description: Ministry of Justice - Incorporation of Chithambara College P. S. A. Trust under Section 114 of the Trust Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the legal incorporation of a trust under the Trusts Ordinance (Chapter 87). It is an Order made by the Minister of Justice exercising powers granted by specific legislation. The content focuses on establishing a legal entity ("body corporate") with defined legal rights and capacities, which falls under the category of legal/regulatory matters concerning statutory instruments and legal frameworks. While a government minister is named, the core substance is the creation of a legal entity and its powers, not a government personnel appointment or structural change.
